assertions.name: Pre-flight Rule Ingestion

assertions.name: Generates Implementation Plan Without Blocking

assertions.name: Executes Code Review Quality Gate & Remediation

assertions.name: Autonomously Persists Learnings to AGENTS.md
assertions.description: The workflow gathers learnings and directly updates the relevant submodule or root AGENTS.md without halting for confirmation.
